{{Infobox auto}}

'''Tonkotsu ramen''' is one of the oven meals. It heals {{Value|Tonkotsu Ramen|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Haste}} {{Value|Tonkotsu Ramen|level|effect=Haste}} for {{Value|Tonkotsu Ramen|duration|effect=Haste}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/ramen.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[ramen stock]] cooks into tonkotsu ramen in {{Value|Tonkotsu Ramen|cook_time}} in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]]. Obtaining the stock unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Tonkotsu Ramen|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Tonkotsu Ramen|heals}} and gives Haste {{Value|Tonkotsu Ramen|level|effect=Haste}} for {{Value|Tonkotsu Ramen|duration|effect=Haste|format=clock}}. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_41.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>

== Advancements ==
* ''The Best Soup!'': make ramen (1 [[obol]]).

{{History|
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|The stock uses oil and accepts seitan.}}
{{History line|Upcoming|2=Villagers can pick it as their [[favorite food]] and buy it once for 1 obol.}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Its translation key is <code>item.kleispack.ramen</code>. It is unrelated to the leftover [[ramen]] item.
